{{Character|name = Sayer|nationality = Unknown nationality|death =|gender = Male|mentioned = {{amol|3}}|lastmentioned = {{amol|3}}|affiliation =|occupation = |image = Wheel-icon.svg|status = Dead}}'''Sayer''' was an acquaintance of [[Androl Genhald]].
== History ==
Androl lost Sayer to fevers during a silverpike run out of Mayene, and that he could have been saved if any others knew what to do. This led to Androl apprenticing himself to a [[Wise Woman]].{{Ref/book|14|3}}

==Trivia==
*Sayer is named for Nathan Sawyer, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
